meaningful_aggregate_deficit_threshold.definition: >=10 confirmed relapse witnesses (C) out of 100 chain-saw cases
meaningful_aggregate_deficit_threshold.basis: round, interpretable, prospectively fixed number -- NOT derived from a significance or power calculation
meaningful_aggregate_deficit_threshold.existence_threshold: 1 confirmed witness is sufficient for an existence finding only, not a meaningful-aggregate-deficit finding

authoritative_decision_table.note: Added in revision 02. Authoritative over any conflicting prose in PROTOCOL.md or the ledger. C = confirmed detector-discovered relapse witnesses; U = ambiguous potential relapse cases under the same frozen candidate/verification rules; defined PER ENDPOINT. [C, C+U] describes possible counts on that discovered candidate set only -- it is NOT a confidence interval, NOT a population bound, and NOT a count of total semantic failures.

rules.interpretation: no verified detector-discovered relapse; NOT a semantic-absence certificate
inconclusive candidate evidence; do NOT call it clean and do NOT treat relapse as rejected
confirmed existence, with ambiguous cases reported separately
practical threshold not reached by the current discovered candidate set

authoritative_decision_table.separation_rule: existence and practical-threshold findings are applied separately (e.g. C=0,U=2 is inconclusive about existence even though the whole current candidate set could not reach ten)
authoritative_decision_table.withdrawn: the revision-01 'ambiguity dominates / no clear majority' criterion is removed; a minority of ambiguous cases can still leave a threshold unresolved
authoritative_decision_table.no_forcing: ambiguity is never reclassified as negative or positive to force a decision, and candidate-selection rules are not changed to reduce U; raw classifier transitions remain reported separately

material_comparative_improvement.note: Added in revision 02, for a QUALIFIED same-method comparator only (s = SEQ, b = BATCH). Conservative range for the SEQ-minus-BATCH confirmed-relapse count difference on the verified candidate set -- not a statistical interval.

rules.interpretation: BATCH shows materially fewer verified-candidate relapse cases than SEQ
the ten-case comparative criterion is not met

material_comparative_improvement.scale_basis: applying the already-chosen ten-case practical scale to this previously undefined comparative condition is a prospective operational choice -- not a power calculation and not outcome-derived
material_comparative_improvement.discordance_rule: SEQ-only and BATCH-only discordance counts are preserved as complementary information in both directions; swapping which cases fail at the same total does not establish lower total relapse, and discordance alone cannot establish material comparative improvement

outcome_precedence: 2. ambiguity-aware primary findings (authoritative decision table applied to SEQ's own C/U)
3. comparator conclusions, only after comparator qualification, resolved by D_min/D_max
4. a stronger applicable existing baseline succeeding -- takes precedence over any inference that a new method is needed
